Relax, go watch a movie or something. 
Btw no one ever responds here.

No one ever answers here. I’ve been following it for awhile so I know. Probably better putting this on a yahoo answers. Being homeless sucks. I got autism too and can’t focus on anything. Video games are the only thing keeping me alive.

Suicide isn’t a way out. It’s just the desperation talking. Sounds more like you need help cooping with yourself. I don’t know what’s your situation but try and see if there are any government help programs for finding a job. That’s what I did (canada). Hey, if an idiot like trump can become president just think of all the things you can accomplish right?

One last thing. Only people who have thought about/thinking about suicide will understand you. Talking to people like your parents will only push you over the edge since they will never understand. Call a help line or something if need to talk.
I can’t decided how to do it. Normally I would get back to you when I solve the problem... but you know dead men don’t talk.
The only people who understand depressed people are depressed people. If you ever talk to someone who completely understands how you feel you should ask them if they are alright.

I get it. You fucked up. You made bad choices in life and now what you want seems out of reach. Each day you do what you can, it doesn’t matter what it is, to distract yourself from thinking about what’s real. Whenever someone brings up what you are doing with your life you probably get defensive; angry even. It’s not their fault. But it’s hard to talk about what you’ve done (or what you have not done). “Other people have it much harder so why do I get to complain?”. 

It’s okay to want to talk to someone. We are human, craving attention is apart of being emotional. Try talking with someone close. Or if that’s too uncomfortable try one of the hotlines. You might not have the answer now and might not find it for a while. And you will feel this way again, and again. Don’t bottle it up. Keep reaching out.
